objects.name: Docker security advisory (AV26-550)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26–550 Date: June 4, 2026 On June 1, 2026, Docker published a security advisory to address a vulnerability in the following product: Docker Desktop – versions prior to 4.76.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates.
